feeds.notes: Standard Clarity: …/WV/<electionId>/<version>/json/en/summary.json, version from current_ver.txt. 11,433 bytes gzipped. Versioned files are Cache-Control: max-age=86400 (immutable per version); current_ver.txt is no-cache. A JSON array of contests with parallel arrays CH (choices), P (parties), V (votes), PCT.
Body is the bare version '386563' (no newline). Last-Modified: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:26:19 GMT.

election_id: '127496', the Clarity election id, the path segment after /WV/. The page URL also carries a web build 'web.345435' that is not needed for data. Found from the link '2026 General Election Results' on https://sos.wv.gov/elections.
discovery: https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/WV/elections.json exists but currently returns '[]' (2 bytes), so it cannot be used. The reliable route is the link on https://sos.wv.gov/elections (an <a> to results.enr.clarityelections.com/WV/<id>/web.<n>/#/summary under the heading '2026 General Election'), then <id>/current_ver.txt.
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent with curl: 200 on everything (CloudFront). Browser User-Agent not needed. Note: headless Chrome (its default 'HeadlessChrome' User-Agent) was refused by CloudFront with '403 ERROR The request could not be satisfied. Request blocked.' on https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/WV/, so there is a WAF rule on some user agents, but the relay's UA passes.
updated_field: electionsettings.json websiteupdatedat = '11/10/2026 11:26:29 AM EST' (US Eastern, zone abbreviation included in the string). summary.json itself has no timestamp; its Last-Modified header was Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:25:46 GMT.
reporting_field: Per contest in summary.json: PR (reporting) and TP (total), which on this statewide site count COUNTIES, not precincts: US Senator TP 55 (West Virginia has 55 counties), PR 52 in en/summary.json but PR 55 in sum.json for the same version (I could not tell which is right; likely 52 fully reported vs 55 with any results). Statewide precincts are in electionsettings.json: stateprecinctsreporting 1642, stateprecinctsparticipating 1642, stateprecinctspartiallyreporting 0.
